items.title: Oscar Peterson interviewed by Joe Williams, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Edward' in the context of Duke Ellington ('Duke — he kept a piano...'), and the interviewee responds only to the question about the instrument ('Fender Rhodes?'), showing no personal interaction or specific relationship with Edward.

ctx.x: I write it down or get it down on an instrument or record it or whatever, because the next day it might not come back, it might not come back.
Edward used to keep — Duke — he kept a piano beside the bed, a little, oh what are those things?
